facts.fact: Liberia's Ministry of Education portal says its EMIS is live for academic year 2024-25 across all 15 counties, publishing school census reports with 1,274,610 enrolled students in 6,394 registered schools.
Liberia's Ministry of Education portal says its EMIS tracks every enrolled learner with a unique LBR identifier across ECE, primary, JSS, SSS, TVET and ABE levels.
